- Set up the project PMU - Develop a proposal for MoLDs organizational structure - Review of the current strategic plan for local development for MoLD - Enhancement of the selection and qualification of local leadership

- The projects PMU is now in place - An initial draft of the proposed structure has been designed and a round of consultations took place with all of MoLD’s leadership. In addition, an initial proposal was developed to enhance the technical office at the Ministry. In addition, comprehensive proposals for the four newly-created departments are designed and discussed with CAOA. - The Project team undertook a reviewing process in a consultative manner with key informants/experts and leadership representatives from the Ministry for validation in an attempt to have a holistic view of the Ministry’s functions and mandates in light of its governing laws. - Coordination meetings took place with the Local Development Training Center in Sakkara. Currently, the Project supports Sakkara’s management to gradually transform the Center first to a professional training center and ultimately to an academy for local development. Moreover, the Project team supports the Training Center in developing an assessment framework for 200 local leaders (through a training program conducted in cooperation with the National Training Academy) as well recommend training domains for 52 programs.

- Present a study on the implementation of the proposed decentralization law in light of international experiences and best practice - Review the methodology and approach to LED and aligning institutional setup, financial arrangement, and implementation framework, & Updating the LED strategies for Fayoum, and Beni Suif Governorates - Conduct an economic assessment and developing a business model for: - Local Development Fund - Your Project Initiative - Affiliate vocational training and handicraft workshops to MoLD - Develop an updated strategic plan for MoLD - Establish a stakeholder engagement plan and MoLD communication plan - Develop a detailed implementation plan of the proposed institutional development reforms - Develop an implementation plan for the reform of the technical office of MoLD - Develop a proposal for the transformation of Sakkara Training Center to an academy for local development in cooperation with other involved players in the development of the Center

-The final LED methodology/model is developed and ready to be adopted by MoLD and dissiminated across governorates in Egypt. - A roadmap for implementation is created to Fayoum and Beni Seif governorates for the first phase of the Project (preparatory stage and first year of implementation 2021). - The National LED strategy will be developed in the coming phase of the Project as it comes as a supporting framework for the LED methodology that is to be applied in the selected governorates. It sets forth supporting roles of national players to the local LED plans - An in-depth assessment to the Local Development Fund was carried out to define the role of the Ministry in promoting LED locally and to determine the current capacity. - The final organizational chart was presented to and approved by the Minister of Local Development. The proposed structure was finally discussed and approved by CAOA. Its official ratification is in the pipeline. - The Project also responded promptly to the technical support request that the Ministry voiced for the resturucturing of the four newly-created departments by developing a comprehensive proposal that is delivered to CAOA. - The Project Team reviewed MoLDs mandates and the current strategic plan for the Ministry coming up with a roadmap for updating the Ministry’s strategic plan. Also, a stakeholder input and analysis document is developed in preparation of MoLD’s strategic plan. - A proposal with the main features of reform for the technical office is developed and communicated to the Minister of Local Development. - A comprehensive proposal for the transformation of Sakkara Training Center to a local development academy is developed. -One of the agreed upon interventions that the Project carries out is the design of the selection and assessment framework for 200 trainees from different offices at the governorate to support decision makers at the local levels (within a training program carried out by the National Training Academy).
